exposure: ELISA test kit (quantifying CA125 and BDNF concentrations in serum)
Six clinical variables from psychometric questionnaires
outcome: Qualitative diagnostic result for endometriosis ("positive" or "negative")
cohort: Serum samples and clinical variables from 77 patients with suspected endometriosis were collected from a biobank.
finding: The developed non-invasive diagnostic test for endometriosis detected 32% of cases with superficial endometriosis and maintained 100% specificity, even in the presence of various confounding medical conditions.
